items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I still hadn’t seen the thing. And I got a little panicked and I enlisted a fellow called David Berger.

ctx.x: There’s two marvelous people, for you, Milt and Mona.

Can you believe it? He’s America’s sweetheart. I mean his feet never touch the ground. He’s in this festival and that jazz party and they yank him back and forth overseas, he’s in Switzerland, he’s in Texas, he’s here he’s there. They never — well that was part of my problem, trying to get that footage. What made me decide to do the movie was him telling me about this home movie that she’d taken. So I just figured I’d better step on it because these people are dropping like flies. Lawrence Brown had just died…
